title: action:menu / action:group / action:icon render a non-string label raw (action:menu throws on a locale map)
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

Found by the seat L1 on PR #37262 (#36717), comment 7157997155, Acceptance note. This is the same family as #36717: #37262 guards `action:button`'s label reads through `renderableLabel`, but its three sibling renderers are outside that card's surface.

## 维护者速读

- **问题：** 按钮的名称如果写成多语言对象（比如 `{ en: 'Approve', zh: '批准' }`），菜单、按钮组、图标按钮三种动作控件会直接显示 `[object Object]` 或空白。菜单控件遇到这种写法会整块崩溃。
- **影响：** 应用作者或 AI 写出这种名称时，用户看到的是乱码或报错，而不是按钮名。
- **改法：** 沿用 #37262 给普通按钮加的同一层显示保护，不新增写法、不改规格。每个控件补一个测试。

## What (read at origin/main)

- `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-group.tsx`: 187 `{action.label}`, 314 and 451 `schema.label`.
- `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-icon.tsx`: 112, 175, 301, 314 (`schema.label?.charAt(0)`, which throws on an object), 324, 331 and 337.
- `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-menu.tsx`: its label reads. On a locale map it throws (L1 7157997155).

Re-check: `git grep -n "schema.label\|action.label" origin/main -- ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/`

## Done when

- Every label read in the three renderers goes through the same `renderableLabel` guard as #37262. It is reused, not forked.
- One pin per renderer, each red on the unguarded code: a locale-map label renders no `[object Object]`, and `action:menu` does not throw.

## Notes

- Size S. Ruling A on #36717 (7118756694) applies, inherited: a render guard only, the spec untouched, nothing translated.
- **Blocked-by:** #36717 (PR #37262), which introduces `renderableLabel` on the button path.
